# Psalm 79 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** A-psalm of-Asaph. O-God have-come nations into-your-inheritance; they-have-defiled your-holy temple; they-have-made Jerusalem into-heaps.

**2** They-have-given the-corpse-of your-servants food for-birds-of the-heavens, the-flesh-of your-faithful-ones for-beasts-of the-earth.

**3** They-have-poured-out their-blood like-water all-around Jerusalem, and-there-is-no one-burying.

**4** We-have-become a-reproach to-our-neighbors, a-scorn and-derision to-those-around us.

**5** How-long O-YHWH? Will-you-be-angry to-perpetuity? Will-burn like-fire your-jealousy?

**6** Pour-out your-wrath upon the-nations which not have-known-you, and-upon kingdoms which on-your-name not have-called.

**7** For they-have-devoured Jacob, and-his-dwelling they-have-laid-waste.

**8** Do-not remember against-us iniquities-of the-former-ones; quickly let-go-before-us your-compassions, for we-are-brought-very-low.

**9** Help-us O-God-of our-salvation, on-account-of glory-of your-name; and-deliver-us and-atone for-our-sins, for-sake-of your-name.

**10** Why should-say the-nations, 'Where is-their-God?' Let-be-known among-the-nations before-our-eyes the-vengeance-of the-blood-of your-servants the-poured-out.

**11** Let-come before-you the-groaning-of the-prisoner; according-to-greatness-of your-arm preserve the-children-of death.

**12** And-return to-our-neighbors sevenfold into-their-bosom their-reproach with-which they-have-reproached-you O-Lord.

**13** And-we your-people and-flock-of your-pasture will-give-thanks to-you to-forever; to-generation and-generation we-will-recount your-praise.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **79:2-3**: Unburied corpses — the ultimate disgrace in ancient Near Eastern culture; echoes of covenant curses (Deut 28:26).

- **79:9**: Double motivation for divine rescue: 'glory of your-name' and 'for-sake-of your-name' — God's reputation is at stake.

— EMET
